newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Northrop soars.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Northrop soars.

text.p: Shares in aerospace company Northrop Grumman Corp rocketed higher before Thursday's market opening, fueled by its $11.6 billion merger with Lockheed Martin Corp.
Traders said the shares were trading at 115, up from a closing price of 88-7/8. The stock had been bid at 114 before it began to trade.
"It's found its level at 115," a trader said.
Lockheed closed at 104 and traders said there was no activity in the stock.

In other active shares, Wyle Electronics was bid at 47 after closing Wednesday at 42-13/16. Germany's Raab Karcher, a unit of VEBA AG, said it would buy the electronics distributor for $50 a share in a deal worth $810 million.

Pharmacia & Upjohn was trading at 35-1/4 after a Wednesday close of 36. The drug company said Thursday negative sales and profit trends would continue through the rest of 1997 but restructuring should turn the company around next year.
Kmart Corp was bid at 10 after closing at 12. The retailer said Thursday it had signed an agreement to buy 20 stores from Venture Stores Inc.
